title: Earning of the CondoGuard Rental Charge Within the Term
content:
Condition of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy on how much of the full-year rental charge of a unit rental endorsement is billed in the current term. The share of the full-year rental charge billed for the rest of the term depends on the policy's payment record and on how the term is billed.

**(a) Returned payment.** When a payment on the policy was returned unpaid fewer than 12 whole months before the day of the endorsement, the rental charge is fully earned and the rental share is one, so the whole full-year rental charge is billed.

**(b) Unbilled installments.** When no payment was returned within that time and the term is on a two-pay or quarterly plan with at least one installment of the current term not yet billed, the rental share is the number of the current term's installments not yet billed divided by the plan's number of installments (2 for two-pay, 4 for quarterly), where the installments billed are the premium installments posted with the current term's effective date.

**(c) Every other case.** In every other case the rental share is the calendar days from the day the endorsement takes effect to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term. This includes the annual, mortgagee escrow and monthly EFT plans (a monthly EFT term has 12 installments), and a two-pay or quarterly term whose installments have all been billed.

| Payment returned in the last 12 whole months | Plan and installments | Rental share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | 1.00, the whole full-year rental charge |
| no | two-pay or quarterly, at least one unbilled | unbilled installments divided by 2 or 4 |
| no | any other | calendar days to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- A payment returned 3 months ago on a quarterly plan with 3 installments unbilled: condition (a) governs, share one.
- No returned payment, quarterly plan, installments 1, 2 and 3 posted: 1 unbilled, share 1 divided by 4.
- No returned payment, monthly EFT plan with 200 of 365 days left: share 200 divided by 365.
- Full-year rental charge 100.00 USD with share one: 100.00 USD is billed; with share 1 divided by 4: 25.00 USD.
